title: Quantum algorithm for solving differential equations using SLAC derivatives
summary: In numerical approaches to solving differential equations on a lattice, a representation of the derivative operator that correctly matches the continuum behaviour of functions of momentum up to the band limit must be non-local. We present the construction of efficient linear-combination-of-unitaries ($\mathrm{LCU}$)-based block-encodings for the first-order derivative and Laplacian operators in the non-local \(N=2^n\)-dimensional SLAC representation. We use state-preparation techniques designed for smoothly decaying functions to prepare the dense $\mathrm{LCU}$ amplitudes with high success…
